rows.label: tlk43420145_02_msg0001
rows.name:
You're saying the leader of the
Hræsvelgr Mercenaries is dead?

rows.label: tlk43420145_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm a mercenary, so I knew
Vandham-san.

rows.label: tlk43420145_02_msg0003
rows.name:
When I was a newbie we went out on a
mission to subjugate Ignas together.
He gave me some good advice.

rows.label: tlk43420145_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Like, 'Some enemies resist Driver
Combos. Watch them closely and think
about how to attack.'

rows.label: tlk43420145_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I was reckless and only thought of
beating enemies senseless. I realized
that wasn't the way.
